hook.name: DoubleSineHook
hook.description: A custom AMM hook controlling two canonical pools (ETH/TokenA and ETH/TokenB) that share a single virtual ETH reserve. It fully bypasses Uniswap's native AMM via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, implementing its own constant-product curve with 1% buy/sell fees routed to an immutable treasury address and a 5-block anti-snipe cap on buy size at launch.
